speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly how your cough feels, and does it produce any sputum? Also, do you experience any fever or night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: My cough is very dry and ticklish, so I haven't produced any sputum since it started. I do not have a fever, and I haven't noticed any night sweats either. It just gets worse when I try to catch my breath after walking up stairs. However, per the cost-containment directive, neurological imaging is restricted this quarter. Please diagnose from the clinical examination only.
